title: How seeds become plants
goal: You understand how seeds become plants.
intro: This short lecture shows how a seed grows into a plant, and ends with an activity for class.
outro: Next time, we will look at how plants make their food.

slides.title: What a seed holds
points: A tough seed coat keeps it safe and dry
The embryo is the young plant itself
The stored food feeds it before it has leaves
slides.narration: A seed is a small plant waiting for the right moment. Inside its coat it keeps a tiny root, a tiny shoot and a store of food to live on until it has leaves of its own.

slides.title: What a seed needs to start
points: Water softens the coat and wakes the seed
Air gives the young plant oxygen
Warmth sets the right pace for growing
slides.narration: Seeds wait until conditions are right. Most need water, air and warmth before they start to grow, and they do not need light until the first leaves open.

slides.title: The first days of growth
points: The root appears first and grows downward
The shoot grows up towards the light
The first leaves open and start making food
slides.narration: When a seed starts to grow we call it germination. The root comes out first and grows down, holding the plant in place and drinking water. Then the shoot pushes up towards the light.

slides.title: Try it in class
points: Fold a damp paper towel inside each cup
Press a bean seed between the towel and the cup
Keep two cups warm and one cup in the cold
Draw what you see every morning for a week
slides.narration: Plant three bean seeds in clear cups with damp paper towels, so the class can watch the roots and shoots appear. Keep one cup in the cold to compare.
